AI-powered phone answering for veterinary practice. Provides intelligent IVR menu with business hours detection, emergency routing, and appointment scheduling options. Returns TwiML for call flow control.

from_.description: Practice phone number (Twilio number, E.164 format)

greeting_text.description: Custom greeting message (optional, auto-generates based on time of day)

returns.description: Call details with TwiML, business hours status, and call_sid if outbound

examples.description: Answer incoming call during business hours

Intelligent call routing to appropriate department or staff member. Routes based on department name (appointments, emergency, billing, vet_tech) or direct phone number. Supports priority levels (normal, high, emergency).

call_sid.description: Twilio call SID to route (format: CAxxxxxxxxxxxxx)

route_to.description: Destination: department name (appointments/emergency/billing/vet_tech) or phone number

priority.description: Priority level: normal, high, or emergency (default: normal)

returns.description: Routing status with destination phone, department, and call status

examples.description: Route emergency call to vet on-call

Send automated appointment reminder via SMS. Includes date, time, veterinarian name, and allows reply to confirm/cancel. Supports scheduled sending (hours_before parameter).

hours_before.description: Hours before appointment to send reminder (default: 24)

returns.description: Reminder status with message_sid and delivery details
